_comment: The judge plan's cross-language corpus. ONE table, two validators:
internal/judge/plan_corpus_test.go        runs judge.ParsePlan and asserts the 'decoder' verdict
plus the subset invariant: schema reject => decoder reject.
The decoder is the AUTHORITY. The schema is deliberately a subset: JSON Schema 2020-12 cannot express
uniqueness of a property across array items, so the two duplicate cases below are decoder-only rejections.
A case the schema rejects and the decoder accepts would be a producer writing plans that never apply -
that is the invariant the Python test enforces, and it is why this file is shared rather than duplicated.

cases.name: minimal: one store, no decisions
cases.why: a judge that kept everything is a valid, successful plan

cases.name: decisions absent entirely
cases.why: Validate does not require the key; nil decodes to an empty slice

cases.name: every verb, with generated_at, note and metadata
cases.why: the full shape the producer writes

cases.name: outcome unavailable with no decisions
cases.why: a call that did not answer is still an outcome with a receipt

cases.name: unknown field at the top level
cases.why: DisallowUnknownFields / additionalProperties false: a dropped field is a decision the operator believes was applied

cases.name: unknown field on a decision
cases.why: same rule one level down

cases.name: unsupported version
cases.why: version is a const, not a minimum

cases.name: version absent
cases.why: an absent version decodes to 0 and is not 1

cases.name: stores absent
cases.why: a plan that names no stores applies nothing and would be receipted as a clean run

cases.name: stores empty
cases.why: same reason; minItems 1

cases.name: blank workspace
cases.why: TrimSpace == "" on the decoder; minLength + a non-whitespace pattern on the schema

cases.name: slug with whitespace
cases.why: the slug rule is the harness's, and there is no slugification anywhere

cases.name: slug with a closing paren
cases.why: a paren in a slug breaks the index line's markdown link

cases.name: slug not ending .md
cases.why: fact files are markdown

cases.name: unknown verb
cases.why: guessing at a producer/consumer disagreement is how a KEEP becomes a delete

cases.name: verb absent
cases.why: no verb is not a KEEP

cases.name: SHORTEN without new_hook
cases.why: a shorten with nothing to shorten to

cases.name: SHORTEN with a blank new_hook
cases.why: whitespace is not a hook

cases.name: SHORTEN carrying mem0_text
cases.why: a shorten does not post to the corpus

cases.name: MIGRATE carrying new_hook
cases.why: a migrate removes the line rather than rewriting it

cases.name: KEEP carrying an edit
cases.why: keep means keep

cases.name: unknown outcome
cases.why: the outcome enum is closed

cases.name: outcome unavailable carrying decisions
cases.why: a call that did not answer has no decisions

cases.name: metadata with a non-string value
cases.why: metadata is map[string]string on the decoder and string-valued on the schema

cases.name: two stores with the same workspace
cases.why: DECODER-ONLY: JSON Schema 2020-12 cannot express uniqueness of a property across array items

cases.name: two decisions for the same slug
cases.why: DECODER-ONLY, same reason: the second decision would silently win
